name: OpenMW Vita
author: KingTorro
description: OpenMW for Vita is a native port of the open-source Morrowind engine, built on vitaGL. Runs the base game plus the Tribunal and Bloodmoon expansions through a custom GLSL pipeline. Dynamic fog scales draw distance on the fly to hold the target framerate, and both controller and front touchscreen are fully supported. Requires game data from a legally acquired copy of The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind.
